style="letter-spacing:-0.5pt;font-size:14.0pt;">AI </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.5pt;font-size:14.0pt;">특화 데이터 체계를 마련하여 매일</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;"> </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">업데이트되는 법령정보의 검색 효율성과 정확성을 높일 계획이다</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">.</span></p><p class="0" style="tab-stops:left blank 270.8pt;letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">  <!--[if !supportEmptyParas]-->&nbsp;<!--[endif]-->  </p><p class="0"><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">  </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.7pt;font-size:14.0pt;">특히</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.7pt;font-size:14.0pt;">, </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.7pt;font-size:14.0pt;">현행의 법령 데이터에 근거하여 답변을 생성하는 검색 증강 생성</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.7pt;font-size:14.0pt;">(RAG)</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;"> </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.6pt;font-size:14.0pt;">체계 마련을 통해 </span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.6pt;font-size:14.0pt;">AI</span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.6pt;font-size:14.0pt;">가 허위 정보나 거짓 답변을 지어내는 환각 현상을 최소화</span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">한다</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">. </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">이와 함께 법령검색과 무관하거나 악의적인 질문을 차단하고 부적절한 답변 생성을 원천적으로 방지하는 </span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">AI </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">안전장치</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">(</span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">가드레일</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">)</span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">를 구축하여 신뢰할 수 있는 법령정보를 제공할 예정이다</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">.</span></p><table style="border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed;border-top:none;border-left:none;border-bottom:none;border-right:none;"><tbody><tr><td style="width:456.38pt;height:17.65pt;padding:1.41pt 5.10pt style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12.0pt;color:#203a7b;">법령검색 서비스 화면 예시 </span><span style="letter-spacing:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:12.0pt;color:#203a7b;">❚</span></p></td></tr><tr><td 법제정보지원국장은 </span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">“</span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">국민 누구나 복잡한 법령정보를 간단한 질문만으로 쉽게 검색하고 활용할 수 있도록 생성형 </span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">AI </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">기반의 혁신 서비스를 완성하겠다</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">”</span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">라면서 </span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">“</span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">인공지능이 산업과 일상의 중심이 되는 </span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">AI </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">시대를 맞아 국민이 체감할 수 있는 공공부문의 </span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">AI </span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">기반 서비스 전환을 차질 없이 추진하겠다</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">”</span><span style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">라고 말했다</span><span lang="EN-US" style="letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">.</span></p><p class="0" style="tab-stops:left blank 270.8pt;letter-spacing:-0.4pt;font-size:14.0pt;">  <!--[if <script type="text/javascript">
//<![CDATA[
	function satisfy_confirm(){
		var fm = document.s_form;
		var selChk = document.getElementsByName("chk_point");
		
		setCookie2("a10501000000", "done", 365);
		
		for(var i = 0 ; i < selChk.length ; i++){
			if(selChk[i].checked == true){
				fm.point.value = selChk[i].value;
			}
		}
		fm.action = "/satisfy.es?mid=a10501000000&act=ins";
		fm.submit();
	}
	if(getCookie("a10501000000") == "done"){
		document.getElementById("satisfyMsg_Y").style.display = "block";
		document.getElementById("satisfyMsg_N").style.display = "none";
		document.getElementById("satisfyForm").style.display = "none";
	}else{
		document.getElementById("satisfyMsg_N").style.display = "block";
		document.getElementById("satisfyForm").style.display = "block";
		document.getElementById("satisfyMsg_Y").style.display = "none";
	}
	
	function setCookie2( name, value, expiredays ){	
		var expire_date = new Date() ;  //오늘날짜를  대입값으로 설정한다.
		expire_date.setDate(expire_date.getDate() + expiredays) ;
		document.cookie = name + "=" + escape( value ) + "; path=/" + "; expires=" + expire_date.toGMTString() + ";";		
	}
//]]>
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function()
{
        var preDay = '2019-02-11';
        var toDay = new Date();
    
        preDay = new Date(preDay);
        diffPreDay = new Date(preDay.getFullYear(), preDay.getMonth()+1, preDay.getDate());
        diffToDay = new Date(toDay.getFullYear(), toDay.getMonth()+1, toDay.getDate());
        
        var diff = Math.abs(diffToDay.getTime() - diffPreDay.getTime());
        diff = Math.ceil(diff / (1000*3600*24));
        var flag = Math.floor((diff / 7) % 2);
        
        if(flag == 0){
	        $("#lawTel").html("044-200-6789,6790");
            $("#lawTelLay").html("044-200-6789, 6790");
        }else if(flag == 1){
            $("#lawTel").html("044-200-6790,6789");
            $("#lawTelLay").html("044-200-6790, 6789");
        }
});
</script>
